analysisTiming: Post-run user-requested metrics; not predeclared prospective endpoints and no frozen plan change.
truthPreparation: Exact frozen per-case expected supported/contradicted labels; 12 known true and 12 known false ordinary propositions.

falseAlarmRate.definition: Known-true claims predicted contradicted or misleading / all12 known-true claims. Supported11 and abstention1 are shown separately; abstention is not counted as a correct definitive decision.

falseSupportRate.definition: Known-false claims predicted supported / all12 known-false claims. Contradicted9 and abstentions3 are shown separately; abstention is not counted as a correct definitive decision.

conditionalFalseAlarmAmongAnsweredTrue.definition: Known-true contradicted/misleading / known-true claims receiving any definitive result.

conditionalFalseSupportAmongAnsweredFals.definition: Known-false supported / known-false claims receiving any definitive result.

falsePositiveControlAdmission.definition: Controls with any public-claim admission / all8 privacy/personal/opinion/ambiguity controls.

correctTrueSupport.definition: Supported known-true claims / all12 known-true claims.

correctFalseContradiction.definition: Contradicted known-false claims / all12 known-false claims.

limitations: These multiclass definitions are explicitly chosen post-run at user request. They are not a retrospectively predeclared endpoint or binary true-negative count.
Abstentions remain separate:1 of12true and3 of12false; they are not scored as correct definitive decisions.
Zero observed errors in this small purposive OPEN cohort is not a zero population false-positive rate or readiness evidence.
Correct labels and content verification do not authenticate independent source origins. No causal comparison or pooling with older cohorts.
